source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: notifyVerification calls getUIConvFromContext only for cancelable or verifiable notifications and returns if that action owner is absent. Non-actionable error notifications can still be created without a live conversation. Cancel and ignore callbacks obtain a fresh Context from cachedUiConv.target when activated. Preserve that lookup timing instead of closing over the original native Context. No runtime teardown race was reproduced.
title: Acquire an OTR conversation only when notification actions need it
